basics.name: Kithmi N. D. Widanage
basics.summary: A doctoral researcher on robot control at the University of Sussex, United Kingdom.

skills: Programming (MATLAB, C++, Python, Java), ROS, FEA (Ansys), CAD (SolidWorks), Graphical Programming (LabView), Control system implementation (Arduino systems, Kionva Gen3 robot, HRX-1 rehabilitation robot)
interests: Robot-environment Interactions, Robot Learning, Assistive Devices, Medical Robotics, Bio-inspired Systems

publications.name: Non-repetitive-path Iterative Learning and Control for Human-guided Robotic Operations on Unknown Surfaces
publications.summary: This paper provides a novel iterative learning and control algorithm for contact-rich tasks that does not require the repetition of exploration regions to learn environmental impedance and perform force control normal to the surface.

publications.name: Developments in circular external fixators: A review
publications.summary: A review article on the design aspects of circular external fixators, a type of orthopaedic device primarily used for stabilizing complex fractures.

publications.name: Exoskeletons for Manual Handling: A Scoping Review
publications.summary: A review article on manual handling exoskeletons.

publications.name: Human-Robot Collaboration for Unknown Flexible Surface Exploration and Treatment Based on Mesh Iterative Learning Control
publications.publisher: 2023 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
publications.summary: A conference paper on a novel iterative learning controller used for performing contact-based operations on unknown surfaces.

publications.name: Multi-Objective Optimization-Based Assist-as-Needed Controller for Improved Quality of Assistance in Rehabilitation Robotics
publications.summary: A conference paper on a multi-objective optimization-based controller for a wrist-rehabilitation robot used for providing safe rehabilitation motions while maintaining the quality of assistance.

publications.name: A Hybrid Powering Mechanism for a Transtibial Robotic Prosthesis
publications.summary: A conference paper on a multi-objective optimization-based controller for a wrist-rehabilitation robot used for providing safe rehabilitation motions while maintaining the quality of assistance.
